name: cli-any-webapi
description: Convert Web system HTTP REST APIs to TypeScript CLI commands for AI Agent consumption. Analyzes source code and API request logs (HAR/CSV) to generate fully-typed Commander.js CLI packages with Bearer Token / Cookie Session authentication.

commands.name: cli-any-webapi
commands.description: Generate a TypeScript CLI package from Web system source code and API logs

commands.name: cli-any-webapi:add
commands.description: Add a single API endpoint to an existing generated CLI package

commands.name: cli-any-webapi:sync
commands.description: Incrementally sync an existing CLI package with updated source or logs

commands.name: cli-any-webapi:list
commands.description: List all generated CLI packages in a directory
